description: Retrieve payment/fulfilment status for exactly one order using its order_id AND private order_token returned during checkout or purchase. After confirmed delivery, the response may include activation code (LPA), QR/install links and available usage data; treat the token and activation information as secrets. This is read-only and never confirms payment by itself; do not share the output publicly.
name: get_order
title: Get order / eSIM status
